title: Product Description Generator
description: A web application that generates e-commerce product titles and selling points based on user-uploaded images and input descriptions.

features.name: Image Upload
features.description: Allows users to upload a product image for analysis.

features.name: Text Input
features.description: Enables users to input a sentence describing their needs for generating product details.

features.name: AI-Powered Content Generation
features.description: Generates an e-commerce product title and three selling points tailored to the provided image and description.

features.name: Youth-Oriented Suggestions
features.description: Provides selling points specifically targeted at younger audiences, based on user input.

constraints: Requires integration with an AI model for image and text processing
Must support common image formats (e.g., JPEG, PNG)
Should ensure data privacy for uploaded images and user inputs
target_users: E-commerce sellers and marketers looking to create product descriptions and selling points
data_requirements: Storage for uploaded images and user inputs, with temporary storage for AI processing
